g.aria-label: Which test uses which wire: Acorn on a Compute Blade
the wire numbers are the flags you put on
P1 cable (JTAG)
GND to GND, Extension Port pin 8
ground: every test's return
TCK to IO4, Extension Port pin 4
test: jtag
TDO to IO3, Extension Port pin 3
test: jtag
TMS to IO14, Extension Port pin 9
test: jtag
TDI to IO2, Extension Port pin 2
test: jtag, its device DNA read
3.3 V from the Acorn: cut back, in no cavity
no test uses it
P2 cable (I/O)
GND to GND, UART pin 2
ground: every test's return
J2 to blade TX, UART pin 3
test: p2-uart, p2-serial
K2 to blade RX, UART pin 4
test: p2-uart, p2-serial
J5: cut back, in no cavity
no test uses it
H5: cut back, in no cavity
no test uses it
3.3 V from the Acorn: cut back, in no cavity
no test uses it
pcie-link and pcie-bar0 go through the M.2 slot; rp1-pio, flash and ddr use no wire of the
cables; scratch uses the serial pair as well.
p2-gpio is never run on a Compute Blade: J5 and H5 are not wired.
Wire colours are for this picture only: the real wires are all black. Count from the plug's pin 1 end.
The plugs are sketched, not from a photograph.
